name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA Pro control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. Version-pinned adapters distinguish public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and documented omissions. Discovery does not grant execution support. The legacy batch writer remains runtime-disabled. Dispatcher ded07x99dcxb504 is connected-read-admitted only on its reviewed tuple; mismatches fail closed. Current readers cover calculations, project metadata, PCB layers, loaded identities and bounded geometry, not complete saved-design inventories. Writing remains limited to eligible unused project-local symbol metadata and schematic-container titles, with separate disposable symbol-copy and PCB-title workflows. Each write needs original ownership, current runtime admission, complete closed-database effect checks and fresh saved readback. General schematic/PCB geometry, referenced-symbol propagation and library writers remain unfinished. The launch-sealed String precreate workflow joins original PCB/project-worker source qualification with two fixed observation sweeps. It cannot create geometry or Save, upgrade an old owner, prove complete latent producers or establish writer eligibility. Installed211943 passed opening/source qualification but stopped at pending/commands/own; original normal closure and release passed with the disposable unchanged. That grouped failure does not identify the individual missing descriptor. The current batch handles24 pinned constructor profiles through retained source-owned instances, including omitted V8 closure bindings, exact function locations, arity and static fields; no constructor is called or original lexical identity claimed. Observation runners recheck ownership after cleanup. Private compiler metadata, five retained raw common-baseline replies, exact supplied common/META history matching and lazy-manager/notification markers support further integration. Missing defaults or unsupported metadata refuse; null managers and retained callbacks are not empty or completed work. These private components, existing encoders, callback profiles, text-base/cache checks, geometry predictions, native create/Save and publication comparators are not a registered writer or complete live/durable baseline. Callback receivers, native effects, separate Save clocks and the full saved/reopened writer lifecycle remain unfinished. Startup and opening use the existing profile and may restore tabs, migrate, replay caches or automatically Save; they are not isolated. Ambiguous calls stay consumed. Inspection, normal closure, proved root/Job termination, helper release and durable settlement are separate steps. No Save/Discard choice, forced termination, blind retry, caller JavaScript or unrestricted Save is supported. Lost ownership cannot be reconstructed from journals. Missing installation files select offline-only startup. The installed-catalog checker uses a separate synthetic profile, not the live owner. Consult the skills and exhaustive coverage inventory for each supported subset and remaining work.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
